phase2Ratchet.label: TC-858 Phase 2 (#548 stack): security fences + required sync paths, approved by Naomi 2026-10-16
phase2Ratchet.toolchain: Bun 1.3.14; replica-e2e Node size job Rust 1.99.0; production webpack; gzip -9 -c

rationale.requiredAtLoad: The web root exports the Node class. Its synchronous sign-out delivery denial, TC-1208 epoch/attempt/signOutCount fences and independent non-replica OpenKey retry cannot move behind an asynchronous replica loader. The measured whole-file marginal includes OpenKey and gzip interactions; it is not a replica-only charge.

The root owns the explicit enabled-constructor registration and synchronous invalid-config refusal; sign-in/restore and wallet selection retain the TC-1208 fences. The optional recovery, storage, authority and worker remain outside the root.

The separately built optional entry calls the root's existing SDK parser and SIWE helpers through these exports, sharing one registry/session and avoiding a second copy of SDK code. This marginal overlaps the index.ts/tcw.ts row and must not be summed.

phase2Ratchet.safeCuts: Bun 1.4.3 controlled combined root reduction -385/-279 against the pre-cut S2 stack: optional-only pure scope predicate reuse -77/-36, then registered synchronous Node config validation -308/-243. S4 event correction changed root by 0. Marginals are nonadditive before-cut attribution, not fabricated exact post-cut per-file gzip; the absolute built combined root ceiling is binding. Base re-measured with the official recipe; earlier provisional base superseded.

hardeningRatchet.label: TC-858 #565 fix-before-stable hardening (L1, L2, I1 and correctness P2s), exact canonical delta
hardeningRatchet.ruling: Naomi TC-858 size ruling for skgbafa/tc-858-l1-l2-i1-hardening: cuts first, remainder by one reviewed exact-delta row at canonical CI bytes
hardeningRatchet.reason: Security L1/L2/I1 and correctness P2 fixes required before stable, plus the round-2 correctness fix for a startup recovery that finishes after its bound. Cuts applied first: the worker start-up report uses reportError (local worker +34 to +7, no client or protocol change); the startup wait reuses the shared bounded helper (local -25/-24); the recovery re-check has no safe smaller bound. Root +20/+11 carries L2's frozen registration copy; first-import +134/+129 carries L2's frozen plugin, the bounded recovery re-check and the single-flight late-startup re-admission; activation +4/+5 is measured with no activation-source change after the cut and is not attributed to one commit. Both jobs of run 39023273615 measured identical absolute bytes in every bucket; the gated artifact is unchanged.

logoutRatchet.label: TC-858 #571 sign-out contract (TC-721 owner revoke, prepared-login retry), exact canonical delta
logoutRatchet.ruling: Naomi TC-858 size ruling for #571: cuts first, remainder by one reviewed exact-delta row at canonical CI bytes
logoutRatchet.reason: Owner-signed direct revoke in DelegationManager (TC-721; +119/+100 locally) and the prepared-login retry in signInWithOpenKey (+115/+89 locally) are the feature. Cuts applied first: the retry loop is one loop and the signOwnerRevocation schema entry is z.custom, together -12/-28 against the first CI measurement of +280/+221; a shared revoke tail would change what the entry carries when authorityCid is undefined and was not taken. The registry-coverage guard and session-field resets are +23/+12 locally. Run 39054822172 measured identical absolute bytes in both jobs against merge base d2b54705. First-import, activation and worker are unchanged (replica.mjs -1 is a measured reduction, not a new allowance).

tc1413Ratchet.label: TC-1413 typed node retry errors (NODE_BUSY, REQUEST_TIMEOUT, OUTCOME_UNKNOWN), exact canonical delta
tc1413Ratchet.ruling: Naomi TC-1413 size ruling: one reviewed exact-delta row at canonical CI bytes; worker, root, first-import and activation only, no unrelated loosening
tc1413Ratchet.reason: One shared classifier (nodeRetryError in sdk-services/src/errors.ts) maps the node's 503 sql_busy / unavailable_retryable / request_timeout and 500 outcome_unknown to NODE_BUSY, REQUEST_TIMEOUT and OUTCOME_UNKNOWN for SQL, DuckDB and KV get/head/list/put/delete, replacing the 503-as-KV_CONFLICT mapping. Cuts applied first: Retry-After is read as whole seconds only (no HTTP-date parsing), one message string per error site is shared with the classifier, and the CLI messages live in the CLI only. The first CI measurement on 90bc0ae7 was worker +946, and the two cuts took it to +827. The review then required mapping the new codes in their consumers (ShareRecipientClient.redactedCode and the operations KV and personal-record failure mappers, which also dropped the dead KV_CONFLICT paths); that moved only the root, by +27/+28, so the final source is 20c29611 with root +278/+302. Run 39099093175 measured identical absolute bytes in both jobs against merge base 3ae17bfc; the worker's 820,935 and the optional deltas are unchanged from run 39095938793. No replica-owned file changed; the growth is sdk-services and sdk-core code bundled into each artifact.

tc1428Ratchet.label: TC-1428 #582 owner-signed artifact pin for addressed shares, exact canonical delta
tc1428Ratchet.ruling: Naomi TC-1428 size ruling for #582: a real shrink first, remainder by the PR's own exact-delta row at canonical CI bytes; rows are relative to the base each PR is measured on, so whichever of #578, #580 and #582 lands later re-measures against the new base and updates its own row
tc1428Ratchet.reason: The viewer now checks the owner-signed artifactPin: assertArtifactBinding and verifyArtifactShare in share-sdk/src/artifact-pin.ts, the strict artifactPin field in the Policy/v3 envelope schema, and their call sites in resolvePolicyShare and ShareRecipientClient.decryptV3Content. Root only: the worker, first-import, activation and gated artifacts are unchanged. Cuts applied first: the layout helpers and the owner-side helpers (buildArtifactPin, verifyArtifactManifestBytes, verifyArtifactFileBytes) live in the separate @tinycloud/share-sdk/artifact entry and are not in the web bundle; pin errors use their code as the message (-159 gzip bytes in a share-sdk proxy build); the recipient no longer re-hashes the fetched bytes, because the binding already makes the pinned digest equal contentSource.initialCiphertextDigestHex, which decryptV3Content checks (-56). Reused: verifyEnvelopeV3SignatureOnly for the signature, the noble sha256 already bundled, and the existing ciphertext digest check; sdk-core and share-envelope hold no equivalent. Not taken: a lazy import, because the web build pins LimitChunkCountPlugin({ maxChunks: 1 }) and would inline it; a subpath for the verifier, because the viewer must run it; dropping the expected-artifact check or the edit refusal, each worth about 35 bytes. Local builds measured +1127/+993 before these cuts. Review changes then showed two canonical-CI surprises that local builds do not reproduce: a zod .max() on the pinned size moved the ESM root by +911..+924 (runs 39143268858, 39144852282), so the bound lives in assertArtifactBinding instead (+17), and folding the two receive-path signature checks into one saved nothing. Run 39147003338 on source dbebc11e measured identical absolute bytes in both jobs against base 7e10709c (its PR base, #579, is byte-neutral).
